subject.title: [Feature]: Allow telegram groups by creating allowList of users

question: Should bundled Telegram add a `groupPolicy: "members"` authorization mode, and if so what fail-closed membership contract should it enforce?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but this grants or denies group access based on Telegram Bot API membership checks and therefore needs maintainer security intent before automation writes the feature.

options.title: Define and implement fail-closed members policy
options.body: Approve a bundled Telegram-only policy that accepts only trusted numeric members, fails closed on uncertain membership checks, and updates config/schema/docs/tests together.

options.title: Keep group allowlists as the supported model
options.body: Reject the new mode and point users to explicit group allowlists or community plugins for softer workflows.

options.title: Move this to an external plugin first
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub experiment unless maintainers identify a missing core/Telegram plugin API seam.

recommendation.title: Define and implement fail-closed members policy
recommendation.body: Approve a bundled Telegram-only policy that accepts only trusted numeric members, fails closed on uncertain membership checks, and updates config/schema/docs/tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: His current-main history and prior review comment are the strongest available routing signal for the affected Telegram/config/docs security surface.
